# Strategen om kronan: ”Elvan är det nya normala”

**Feed**: dagen-med-di

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

## Episode Thesis

This macro segment has Danske Bank FX strategist Jesper Fjärstedt talking about why the Swedish krona has weakened this year. He puts it down mainly to Swedish capital flowing into US equities and to the negative interest-rate gap with the ECB, and he criticises the Riksbank for only warning about the krona when it gets too strong. He forecasts EUR/SEK at 11.50 and USD/SEK at 10.25 in 12 months and calls 11 'the new normal'. The co-host adds that a weaker krona gives Swedish exporters, especially large engineering firms, a tailwind and easier year-on-year comparisons. No individual stock views are given.
